create_actor_critic_rnn_agent: create an ActorCriticRNN agent with a custom network, optimizer, and hyperparameters for reinforcement learning
create_default_agent: create a default actor-critic RNN agent with Adam optimizer and LSTM using default hyperparameters
run_select_action: run select_action on the agent to get a softmax policy action from a timestep observation
run_update_agent: run update on the agent to add a transition to the buffer and perform SGD when full
review_agent_state: review the AgentState NamedTuple holding network parameters, optimizer state, and RNN states
